title: Machine learning selects Eu²⁺-activated green and blue-green phosphors
summary: A bagged gradient-boosted regression model trained on 129 Eu²⁺-activated phosphors predicted emission wavelengths and helped select 20 host candidates for synthesis. The authors report three Eu²⁺-activated phosphors with green or blue-green emissions: Li₂Ca₄Si₄O₁₃:Eu²⁺, Na₂Ca₂Si₂O₇:Eu²⁺, and SrLaGaO₄:Eu²⁺. The host compounds were known; novelty concerns their activator-specific luminescence. Some powders contained impurities, and selected-particle diffraction/spectroscopy characterization does not establish phase-pure bulk yields or device suitability. This is one campaign.
organization: Research and Services Division of Materials Data and Integrated System, National Institute for Materials Science; Osaka Metropolitan University; Research Center for Functional Materials, National Institute for Materials Science

source_review.scope: Primary full article/PDF, date, affiliations, methods/results, candidate measurements and stated limitations.

evidence.tested: Twenty candidates were synthesized and characterized; three showed designed green or blue-green Eu²⁺ emission.
evidence.unknown: Some samples contain impurity phases; selected-particle evidence and host-specific results do not establish phase-pure bulk/device performance or complete prior-art priority.
evidence.ai_role: A model trained on known phosphors ranked host candidates by predicted emission wavelength for experimental synthesis and characterization.
